maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from marketing agency services, creative, media and digital projects and retainers, not repair or upkeep of installed things.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are mainly private B2C, B2B and DTC brands; political work is a small part of revenue.

serial_acquirer.reason: Built as a network of acquired agencies (Code and Theory, Anomaly, Doner, Crispin) with a steady stream of agency acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Brands can re-pitch or move marketing, media and creative agency work with moderate effort; no regulatory or technical lock-in.
